children: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen takes a moment on the company's third-quarter earnings call to congratulate his incoming successor, Anil Chakravarthy--and to thank David Wadhwani, the Adobe creative executive many analysts assumed would be helming the company after Narayen's exit. Analysts have seen Chakravarthy's selection as a signal that Adobe will focus more closely on its customer experience orchestration business. Narayan, who says Adobe had "two great internal candidates," says the board was seeking "somebody who would embrace everything that the company had in terms of the opportunity and then figure out how they wanted to transform it moving forward." Chakravarthy says he sees opportunity "across the three product categories and across the entire range of customers." (elias.schisgall@wsj.com)
